verdict.rationale: Pipecat is itself an official open-source Python framework (SDK). A runtime probe confirms it pip-installs and imports keylessly. Pipecat also ships an official family of client SDKs for web and mobile, plus pre-built React components, which handle transport, session management, and events. Community users confirm building against it with providers onboarded in a few lines of code. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent verification of the client SDKs, and a documented list of the specific mobile platforms and languages they cover.
